review_method: All 960 candidate source strings individually read with index_interface.source_text(), which verified indexed byte hashes. Categories follow observed semantics plus adjacent-offset context. No runtime/MIPS consumer tracing performed. No Japanese transcript exported.
coverage_limitations: Covers every candidate in this index, not every executable/interface string.
Index selects Japanese-bearing CP932 spans and therefore omits English-only labels, standalone punctuation fragments, graphics, scripts, and strings outside the scanned range.
Adjacent pool membership is context, not proof of shared consumers or reachability.
Fallback and other-installment strings are retained for audit, not deleted or assumed unreachable.
Source-composed notifications require control-flow and complete-message reconstruction before translation.
Chapter/location titles may appear in save, gallery or battle menus; exact consumers remain unverified.
